title: The product owner's reading of a requirement

understood.description: What the requirement asks for, in a few sentences, as the analyst understood it.

why.description: What goes wrong if this is guessed.

blocking.description: True when building on a guess could waste the work or do harm.

assumptions.description: What the team will take as given without asking, so the owner can object.

size.description: small: one clear change to a few files with nothing left to decide (a fix, a copy change, a config value); built without acceptance tests written first. normal otherwise, and when unsure.
